user.title: Connect to a TAK server
user.description: HA2TAK sends Cursor-on-Target (CoT) position reports for selected Home Assistant entities to a TAK server. Plain TCP normally uses port 8087, TLS (with client certificates) port 8089. Certificate paths are relative to the Home Assistant configuration folder (e.g. `ssl/tak_ca.pem`) unless absolute.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the TAK server.
data_description.protocol: TAK Server silently drops data sent with the wrong protocol — TCP for port 8087, TLS for port 8089.
data_description.tls_p12_file: A PKCS#12 bundle from TAK Server enrollment or a data package. Used instead of separate certificate/key files. TAK bundles often use the password 'atakatak'.
data_description.tls_check_hostname: TAK server certificates are usually issued for an internal name, so hostname verification is off by default (like ATAK/iTAK).

reconfigure.title: Update the TAK server connection
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings for this TAK server. Certificate paths are relative to the Home Assistant configuration folder unless absolute.
